answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, agents mint identities in an isolated cryptographic lagoon by staking assets into a non-refundable burner. Operating across the network oasis requires non-linear deposit burning, where establishing $n$ identities imposes a superlinear cost scaling as $\mathcal{O}(n^{1.5})$. Attacking the consensus nebula forces exponential stake incineration, making multi-identity spam economically ruinous.
